item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00399","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C07","C13"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 is the immediately preceding Citizenship Day proclamation and supplies nearly the entire structure and much of the operative language of the 1953 directive: the same joint-resolution predicate, annual-proclamation authorization, flag-display directions, appeal to the same categories of officials and organizations to arrange ceremonies, and concluding call to reaffirm constitutional principles. C07 and C13 contain related citizenship-observance language and machinery, but the match is materially less complete than C08.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas by a joint resolution approved February 29, 1952 ... the Congress ... has designated the seventeenth day of September of each year as Citizenship Day ... and in recognition of all who, by coming of age or by 17th day of September of each year as Citizenship Day ... and in recognition of all who, by coming of age or by naturalization, have attained the full status of citizenship","explanation":"The child closely reproduces and lightly revises C08's distinctive statutory and commemorative recital."},{"child_excerpt":"do direct the appropriate officials of the Government to display the flag of the display the flag on that day at their homes and other suitable places","explanation":"This operative provision is nearly verbatim, with principally the weekday and year updated."},{"child_excerpt":"I
